description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the LeaveConfigurationService within the OrangeHRM project. It tests various configuration retrieval and setting methods related to leave management, such as getLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy, getWorkScheduleImplementation, and leave period status handling.
